notes.title: 10th Anniversary of Notch Series and a New Title
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10863167/2274333ffa25b98b836e2bc057cb5c0772197a0d.jpg[/img]

March 2018 marks the 10th anniversary of the Notch series. We'd like to thank you all for the attention and support you’ve given to AngelsBlue.

We’d also like to take this opportunity to reveal a new project in the Notch series to you all. We are now developing Notch Zero, which has a brand new storyline. Apart from having a long story, multiple routes/endings, a new engine, and enhanced gameplay, there will also be more than 60 tracks in Notch Zero. We also intend to invite a famous singer to join the music production. As this will be a larger project, the work involved is expected to take a little longer. 

Here, we also hope that all of you will continue to support us. The past decade has not been easy for us, and we sincerely hope that the Notch series will continue on so we may have more opportunities to bring more impressive stories to everyone. Whether you are a new player or an old friend, or whether you prefer the Steam version or the physical version, your support greatly encourages us. We hope that you’ll continue to stay with us for the next decade.

For more information regarding the Notch series, please visit AngelsBlue's website (Chinese): https://angelsblue.org/

notes.content:

- Fixed the achievement “Crystal Memories” not unlocking in some situations.
- Slightly decreased the evil spirits’ speed so it is now easier to escape from them in Hard difficulty.

- Other small fixes.

If you find anymore bugs, please don’t hesitate to report them here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/546080/discussions/0/152391285463007976/

notes.title: Coffin of Ashes - Now Available
notes.content:
After several months' development, Coffin of Ashes is now available on Steam!

Under Steam and the support of a new engine, we've added some features such as cloud saving, achievements, and full controller support. If you have any suggestions or want to report a bug, please head to this thread:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/546080/discussions/0/152391285462989161/

Thanks for your support. We hope you will enjoy the game. ːlismileː
